verdict.rationale: Digits lists an Invoicing product ('Get paid faster') on its AGL page, so first-party invoicing exists, but nothing in the pack documents how invoices are created and sent, what online payment methods are offered, or whether view and paid status is tracked. Missing for 10: documented invoice creation and sending workflow, online payment options on invoices (card/ACH), invoice viewed/paid status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid
